newsitem.title: GERMANY: TBWA agency wins Elf German advertising account.
newsitem.headline: TBWA agency wins Elf German advertising account.

text.p: Elf Oil's German unit has awarded its advertising account to the TBWA group, TBWA Germany's chief executive and chairman, Helmut Sendlmeier, said on Wednesday.
Elf selected TBWA Hamburg and TBWA Berlin from the six agencies who presented a pitch, Sendlmeier said, adding that the goal of the new campaign is to strengthen Elf's position in eastern Germany.

"Among the responsibilites in the campaign for Elf include increasing recognition of the company name, especially in the eastern states, the core market for Elf Oil Germany," Sendlmeier said in a statement.
The campaign is scheduled to begin in autumn of this year.
